title: Love It
text: Love It. so far so good  definitely not for big jobs  but  i had a dust buster  but i was tired of bending over  .. as i have bad knees, etc.  this was perfect and i love the color  just good for "crumby" jobs  dont expect miracles on a big area of carpeting

product_metadata.title: Dirt Devil Simpli-Stik Lightweight Corded Bagless Stick Vacuum, Teal
features: Innovative stick vacuum includes an easy off detachable hand vacuum
Weighs less than 4 Pounds- lightweight construction for comfortable carrying
Smooth-rolling wheels and convenient cord wrap for 16 foot cord
1.25 Amp Motor- cut through messes with constant suction power and 120 V
Includes an onboard crevice tool for hand vacuum to easily get into tight spaces
description: Designed for the way you live! this innovative stick vac is perfect for rugs and hard floors, and it features an easy lift off hand vac. Just detach the hand vac and you are ready for dust, dirt and crumbs on furniture, counters, shelves, upholstery and drapes. An on-board crevice tools allows you to reach tight spaces in corners, around furniture and along the edges of delicate electronics. A lightweight design lets you move the vacuum from room to room and up and down stairs. The smart, bagless design is easy to empty.

details.Special Feature: Stick vacuum converts to hand vacuum
